g.title: Medium shot. Alice, left, scared, sweating, looking at Bob; Bob, right, arms crossed, angry, looking at Alice. Bob: Where is my umbrella?
Medium shot. Alice, left, angry, swearing, looking at Bob; Bob, right, arms crossed, angry, looking at Alice. Alice: It was hideous!
Medium shot. Alice, left, sad, dizzy, looking at Bob; Bob, right, arms crossed, bored, looking at Alice. Alice: I spun it round. Very fast. Then it was gone.
Full shot. Alice, left, surprised; Bob, centre, pointing, shouting, dashing off. Alice: Bob?
